title: SBC: Southern Baptists for Civility?

body: If SBC folks accept this pastor’s challenge, their future could be very different from their last few decades … Wade Burleson offers a positive example of what I wrote about the other day … a conservative (his word) white male speaking to conservative white males about their need for more graciousness and civility toward “the other,” whether “the other” is women, people of other races, people of other theological persuasions, or people of other religions.
